scope: map switching works: an mp_afghan gamestate loads to state 10
server_change: native_gamestate takes a mapname; gameserver exposes --gamestate-map; configstring 0 is rewritten to match

experiment.note: this was the FIRST gamestate of the session, not a mid-session map change

significance: the map name in the gamestate is honoured by the client and a different map still reaches state 10
so the gamestate path can drive map selection; what remains untested is a MID-SESSION change (state 10 -> new gamestate -> reload)
next: send cross_fire first, wait for state 10, then send an afghan gamestate and watch for state 8 -> 10
that would prove in-session map change, the basis for match restart / map rotation
